rv.q: Miranda tells that history through a thrilling mixture of hip-hop, rap, R&B, jazz, and traditional musical theatre, transforming names we learned in history class into complicated, passionate, and often very messy human beings.
HAMILTON stands as Eliza’s triumph at not being forgotten, not being erased, not being the footnote to a footnote in history.
This masterpiece in music and American history will be playing at the Dr. Phillips Center from now through Sunday, Oct. 18, kicking off the Broadway in Orlando 2026-2027 season.

cn.t: Critics hail Hamilton as a revolutionary masterpiece that remains thrilling over a decade later, with particular praise for its music and reimagining of American history through Eliza's perspective.
